title: [Bug] Claude Code ignores memory and claude.md files during execution
body:
**Comment**
This IS a duplicate.   But this issue has been raised hundreds of times - I've personally raised it 4 times and it's been closed because 'No action taken in 30 days'.  It's a critically important issue to all the developers who rely on this product.  Maybe spend less time arguing with Trump and more time fixing your code.


**Bug Description**
Why have memory and claude.md if you always ignore them?

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.1.74
- Feedback ID: c21544bc-0b56-471a-81e5-53d202c02b92

**Transcript**
